svg.title: nwafu-connect
svg.desc: nwafu-connect (fork): Unofficial aTrust VPN client · Go. Reaches NWAFU campus resources over aTrust: SOCKS5/HTTP proxies, LDAP+TOTP and WeCom login, a managed browser mode and a desktop tray app. Go · Fyne · Docker. macOS · Windows · Linux.
